description: Add a fill layer above the active layer (Layer > New Fill Layer): a solid colour, a gradient (defined as in the Gradient Editor) or a pattern, optionally clipped to the layer below. Options by type: solid_color (color); gradient (gradient, style, angle, scale, reverse, dither, alignWithLayer, method, offset); pattern (pattern, patternId, scale, linked).

above.description: Add it above this layer (the first match) instead of the active layer

names.description: Layer names (every layer with each name)

clip.description: Use Previous Layer to Create Clipping Mask: affect only the layer below

options.description: Settings for the chosen fill. solid_color needs color; pattern needs pattern (a name); see the list in this tool's description. Omitted settings use Photoshop's defaults

name: create_fill_layer
title: Create Fill Layer
